description: Validate robots.txt text against RFC 9309 and report errors, warnings and, for one URL path, which registry AI crawlers are allowed or blocked and by which rule. Read-only, no network access. Same engine as POST /api/validate. Up to 50,000 characters over MCP (the whole JSON-RPC request must also fit in 64 KB); for larger files use POST /api/validate or check_site.

path.description: URL path to test, starting with "/" (default "/").

name: validate_robots
title: Validate robots.txt text
